_comment: TIME axis (decoupled Sun & Light, Stage 2). 'time' = sun day-arc presets (time_of_day h, daylight window, peak elevation, azimuth sweep). 'day_script' = the daytime COLOR SCRIPT: anchors by hour that time_of_day interpolates for sky/sun-color/ambient (a cheap keyframed day — the physical GPU atmosphere is a separate future stage). NOTE: the 6 lighting_moods.json moods still reproduce via MoodToStates (picking a mood overrides the script with its authored colors); the script is the default procedural day for scrubbing time_of_day.
